issues.description: The ArrayHelpers class in the template defines the method appendElement(...) but other classes (e.g., Stock.addToStockIngredients) call ArrayHelpers.addElementToArray(...). This naming mismatch causes a compile error in the template and will block students from building/running the project.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the ArrayHelpers method name consistent across repositories. Rename the method appendElement(...) in the template to addElementToArray(...) (matching Stock.java usage and the solution), or alternatively change calls in Stock.java to use appendElement(...). The recommended fix is to rename the template method to addElementToArray to match the rest of the code and the solution implementation.
